nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riot, the single woman shown from multiple angles in <Picture 1>. She is a lean athletic woman in her mid-thirties with short tousled copper-red hair, a black cropped leather jacket, black top, black cargo trousers, and black combat boots. The turnaround shows one woman only.
<Subject 2> is the monumental open-air Orrery enclosure in <Picture 2>, with a circular wet black-stone platform, broad central steps, massive monoliths, a continuous upper ring, and one wide frontal entrance aligned with the central mechanism.
<Subject 3> is the central astronomical mechanism shown at architectural scale in <Picture 2> and in close mechanical detail in <Picture 3>. It has a black gold-veined globe, exactly two cratered moons, black-and-brass orbital rings, inward-facing moon carriers, support arches, bearings, gears, and a circular base. The foreground moon is mounted at the inner tip of a short carrier that curves toward the central globe, placing the moon inside the orbital structure beneath the upper arch.
<Subject 4> is the stormy Scottish Highland environment in <Picture 2>, with fine rain, cold blue-grey daylight, distant ridges, wet stone, and intermittent wind.
<Video 1> is the continuation source, establishing <Subject 1> walking along the central approach toward the wide frontal entrance, central steps, and <Subject 3>.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation] The target video continues from <Video 1> with an eight-second interior reverse angle. <Subject 1> enters through the same wide central opening, climbs the steps, and walks onto the inner floor. A foreground moon and inward-facing carrier frame the shot while the camera moves laterally through the mechanism. Early synchronized chain, gear, and bearing sounds introduce a small controlled orbital movement.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Riot’s identity, hair, clothing, proportions, wet appearance, and walking state are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the wide central entrance, two framing columns, central steps, wet platform, and monumental ring are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the globe, exactly two moons, orbital rings, inward-facing carriers, gears, supports, and architectural scale are retained.
<Subject 4> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the cold storm lighting, rain, wind, distant Highlands, and wet surfaces are retained.
<Video 1> (opening continuity): partially_preserved - Riot’s approach direction, central alignment, weather, and destination continue through a reverse interior camera angle.

detailed_description:
The target video uses grounded cinematic realism, restrained performance, cold storm lighting, shallow foreground depth, and precise synchronized sound.

[Shot 1] The video hard-cuts from the end of <Video 1> to a camera positioned inside <Subject 2>, beyond <Subject 3> and facing outward along the same central entrance axis. The perspective resembles a 52mm lens at chest height.

The wide frontal entrance fills the background, framed by two primary monoliths. <Subject 1> appears centrally within this opening and advances toward the broad central steps.

One cratered moon from <Subject 3> occupies the soft-focus lower-left foreground. Its short brass carrier curves diagonally inward and right toward the central globe, with the moon positioned at the carrier’s inner tip. Its orbital path forms a low shallow arc around the globe, comfortably beneath the upper support arch. The black gold-veined globe occupies the right midground. The second moon remains attached to a separate carrier near the opposite side of the globe.

The camera begins a slow lateral dolly from right to left, moving approximately forty centimetres across the shot. The foreground moon and carrier create strong parallax while Riot and the distant columns remain comparatively stable. A gentle counter-pan keeps Riot framed through the central opening.

Riot climbs the wet central steps with measured confidence. Cold exterior light rims her copper-red hair and shoulders, while reflected light from the wet floor keeps her face and black clothing readable.

At approximately 00:01.600, a hidden drive chain draws taut with a restrained metallic pull.

At approximately 00:02.200, one gear assembly performs a precise click followed by a heavier seated engagement. The lower orbital ring and its inward-facing foreground moon carrier begin advancing slowly by approximately three degrees. The moon travels laterally along its low inward arc around the globe as low bearing friction becomes audible.

At approximately 00:03.000, Riot crosses between the entrance columns and plants one boot on the inner black floor. The heel strike displaces a thin layer of rainwater and produces a short hard-stone reflection.

Riot continues forward while turning her attention toward the moving mechanism. She shortens her stride slightly and raises her chin, remaining guarded and professionally attentive.

The orbital movement settles during the final second. The camera completes its lateral slide as Riot stops a few feet away from <Subject 3>, ending on one resonant bootstep with the globe, both moons, and layered rings clearly readable.

overall_soundscape:
Fine rain strikes stone, leather, fabric, and brass. Highland wind passes intermittently through the open monoliths. Riot’s footsteps progress from wet stairs to harder inner-floor impacts. Controlled breathing, leather movement, and damp fabric remain audible. Mechanical sound consists of early chain tension, one measured gear engagement, and low bearing friction synchronized with the small orbital movement.

N/A
